$comment: opencode runtime settings for ALAN. Merge the `agent` block into your opencode.json; the prompt is portable/opencode/agents/alan.md and opencode reads it from .opencode/agents/alan.md.
$permissionComment: ALAN must not commit or push — that is stated as a hard prohibition in the prompt, not enforced here. opencode's permission model is coarse (allow/ask/deny per tool class), so it cannot express 'bash yes, git push no'. If you need that enforced rather than instructed, set bash to ask.
